{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rectifiers''' were a group of individuals that served the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Christoph Jam]], the head of the corporation [[Descorp]]. Jam tasked the Rectifiers with avenging injustices that had been committed against innocent victims that were unable to defend themselves. Jam paid the Rectifiers well and he sometimes used his company's wealth to fund them.
